strategy.title: No executable plan: settlement of solar permit package sales within 10 days is not established
strategy.why: Reach (published business emails), demand, $400 price, 10% paid conversion, Brain-produced delivery at $20 and $0 exposure are evidenced, and five sales would carry $2,000, but the card records no payment terms or time to first cash, so nothing shows the money is usable inside the 10-day window.

alternatives.title: Sell five packages and assume card payment settles in time
alternatives.why: Assuming settlement timing would count money that may settle after the deadline; it is a fact to establish, not assume.

steps.label: Establish the path from first contact to usable cash: installer purchasing approval, payment terms and payout timing, in days

quantities.name: timeToFirstCash
quantities.unit: days from first contact to usable cash
quantities.needs: Published payment terms and payout timing for this sale, showing usable cash within 8 days of first contact

sources.claim: 150 solar installers hold state contractor licences; each files 10 interconnection applications a month.

noPlan.decisiveGap: SETTLES_IN_TIME: the opening has no recorded payment terms or time to first cash, so it is not established that $2,000 from five $400 sales becomes usable cash within 10 days.
noPlan.resolution: Research and record the payment terms and payout timing (days from first contact to cash in the account); if usable cash arrives within about 8 days, sell five packages to installers by published email at $400; if not, relax the deadline to cover the measured settlement time.
